name: Bun cha ca
summary: Bún chả cá is the bowl Vietnam Tourism’s dining chapter tells you to order by pulling alongside a noodle boat at Cái Răng. A recipe was not printed.
origin: The Mekong dining chapter, at Cái Răng. Not a different city’s fish-noodle page.
howToEat: On the noodle boat during the market.
